ambient_events: A file goes over metal eleven times and then the work is turned.
The forge gets one pump of the bellows and settles back down.
A tool goes back on the board, into its own outline, without anybody looking at the board.
description: An open-fronted workshop with the tools hung on a board, each on its own painted outline, and not one outline empty. Whatever is being made in there is being made by hand and is being made slowly.
name: The Bench
